groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk
conditions: 250,000 credits is a big single spend; do not empty your account on other Baro items first.
bonuses: Void Cascade, or fast low-level Capture, Rescue and Exterminate fissures with a speed or nuke frame (Titania, Volt, Mag, Gyre).
In public squads prefer Defense over modes where one slow player stalls extraction.

disclosures.title: other Ducat sources
disclosures.body: Aya buys Ducats from Varzia during Prime Resurgence. Baro's Void Surplus (50,000 cr) has a 2% chance at 1,000 Ducats. Vaulted-then-reissued parts are worth 25 and 65 Ducats.

disclosures.title: closed routes
disclosures.body: Operation Breeding Grounds awarded it and The Gradivus Dilemma never did. Neither is a source now. Trade works only for unranked copies with no Forma or Catalyst, and the buyer must be MR 3 or higher.

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for about 48 hours
conditions: His stock changes each visit and this weapon is not on every one. A long absence is not a removal; it has returned repeatedly.
